title: Constructing Pareto Frontiers of Optimal Reasoning Termination Methods for Overthinking in Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13570v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning models can benefit from test-time scaling, but continued reasoning may become ineffective or harmful, a phenomenon termed overthinking. Evaluations against full thinking compare accuracy and token usage but lack references for overthinking severity and strategies' theoretical mitigation potential. To characterize overthinking at the model-task level, we first introduce Step-wise Truncation Probing (STP), repeatedly generating answers from multiple retained prefixes along each fixed sampled reasoning trajectory. Using each trajectory's earliest measured position attaining maximum empirical accuracy as a reference, we define Overthinking Ratio and Accuracy Degradation as the fraction of thinking tokens generated afterward and the accuracy decrease from this reference to full thinking, respectively. translated_title: 构建推理模型中过度思考的最优推理终止方法的帕累托前沿
translated_abstract: 推理模型可以从测试时扩展中受益，但持续的推理可能变得无效甚至有害，这种现象被称为“过度思考”。目前针对完整思考过程的评估只比较准确率和token使用量，缺乏衡量过度思考严重程度以及各类策略理论缓解潜力的参照基准。为了在模型-任务层面刻画过度思考，我们首先引入了逐步截断探测方法，在每条固定的采样推理轨迹上，从多个保留的前缀重复生成答案。以每条轨迹上最早达到最大经验准确率的测量位置作为参照，我们定义了过度思考比率和准确率退化，分别表示其后生成的思考token所占比例，以及从该参照点到完整思考的准确率下降幅度。其次，我们将动态路由、固定预算和动态提前退出纳入统一框架，以量化各方法的理论缓解潜力……
tldr: 该论文提出逐步截断探测（STP）方法来量化推理模型的过度思考程度，并在统一框架下评估动态路由、固定预算和动态提前退出等终止策略，构建了准确率与效率之间权衡的帕累托前沿。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Step-wise Truncation Probing (STP) to quantify overthinking severity in reasoning models and constructs Pareto frontiers of optimal termination strategies, including dynamic routing, fixed budgets, and dynamic early exit, within a unified framework.
